acv.quote: We proposed six hundred K a year.

header.reason: Angela, the COO, signed with Adyen after we never showed a till return or a store rollout plan. Tom thought Raj decided and that winning online mattered, but stores decided it.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with returning an online order at the store till.

line.text: Unify online and in-store commerce: the line between online and in-store has all but disappeared

findings.why: Angela watched a holiday returns queue because stores couldn't see online orders.
findings.quote: The store couldn't see the online order

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Tell store-side leaders who answers when tills fail, not only payments.
findings.why: Angela signed with Adyen, and our answer on installs was to 'bring in a partner'.
findings.quote: I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer store rollout questions: installs, wifi drops, Saturday till outages.
findings.why: Per Raj, secondhand, Adyen brought people who'd done store rollouts. Afterward most questions were about stores.
findings.quote: Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace the line has disappeared with a step-by-step till return.

line.text: Unify online and in-store commerce: the line between online and in-store has all but disappeared

findings.why: Bev, head of store operations, dismissed our unified commerce slide and asked how a return works.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a retailer story with rollout dates, installs and old tills.

line.text: URBN consolidates $5 billion in online and in-store revenue onto Stripe

findings.why: Angela wanted to call the retailer in our case study, and we couldn't arrange it in time.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'the tills', not 'point of sale' or 'unified commerce'.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Bev used this phrase every time, while we kept saying 'in-person payments' and 'point of sale'.
findings.quote: One system for the tills and the website.
